name: Papercut Series - Bo3
author: idol_val
description: Papercut Series Bo3 on a 7-map pool. A coin is flipped and the winner decides who goes first, then: A ban, B ban, A pick (B side), B pick (A side), A ban, B ban, then the first mover picks side on the decider.
notes: 7-map pool: full Season 3 ranked pool minus Cosmite and Port Euler.
